Vendored renderer backends: Vulkan, OpenGL3 (including loader), Direct3D12, Metal.
Vendored platform backends: GLFW, Win32, macOS (OSX).
All backend files are unmodified sources from the commit above.
Rubia currently builds/initializes GLFW + Vulkan only; the other backends are
source dependencies for future adapters, not enabled engine implementations.
